This gallery collects visual work from projects involving oceanographic data, animal movement, and remote sensing. Each entry includes a short description rather than a separate project page.

<h2>Ocean movement</h2>
<p>Animated HYCOM water-velocity data show how ocean movement and elevation can be visualized across space and time.</p>
</article>

<article class="visualization-card">
<img src="moveVis1.gif" loading="lazy" alt="Animated visualization of tagged shark movement." />
<h2>Shark tracking</h2>
<p>This visualization presents the movement patterns of tagged sharks through time and across their surrounding marine environment.</p>
</article>

<article class="visualization-card">
<img src="image1.gif" loading="lazy" alt="Animated map of ocean salinity generated with Google Earth Engine." />
<h2>Ocean variables</h2>
<p>Google Earth Engine animations compare mapped ocean conditions such as salinity, temperature, and water velocity.</p>
</article>
